title: About MyLearnPlus
summary: MyLearnPlus is the training school of Livezen Technologies, teaching Adobe Creative Cloud and generative AI online and in Colombo.

blocks.heading: A training school for Adobe and AI skills
blocks.subtitle: We teach Creative Cloud and generative AI to people who have to produce finished work, not just understand the theory.

blocks.body:
MyLearnPlus is an operating business of Livezen Technologies. We run instructor-led classes online and in Colombo, and we publish a self-paced library for people who cannot sit in a scheduled class. Everything we teach is software people are expected to use at work: Adobe Creative Cloud, generative AI tools, and the design and web skills that sit alongside them.

Our catalogue covers three pillars. The Adobe Creative Cloud pillar runs from Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign through Premiere Pro, After Effects, Lightroom, Acrobat Pro, Adobe Express and Adobe Firefly, at introductory and advanced level. The AI and generative AI pillar covers foundations for non-technical staff, prompt engineering, AI assistants at work, generative AI for designers, AI video and audio, AI for marketing, automation and agents, building with LLM APIs, and governance and responsible use. The design and digital pillar covers Figma and UI/UX, web design with WordPress, digital marketing analytics, and presentation and data visualisation.

Classes are taught by working practitioners, in small groups, on live files. In a Photoshop class you retouch a real portrait and hand back a layered file that survives a client revision. In an InDesign long-document class you build a report with running headers, an automatic table of contents and an index. In an AI automation class you leave with a working assistant connected to a tool. If an outcome on a course page says you will build something, the module where you build it is listed in the curriculum on the same page.

We are based in Colombo and sell in two currencies. Learners and organisations in Sri Lanka pay in LKR; everyone else pays in USD. The same syllabus, materials and instructors apply to both.

blocks.heading: How you can study with us

cards.title: Live online
cards.text: Scheduled classes taught in real time, capped so the instructor can look at your screen and your work. You keep the recording for twelve months.

cards.title: Classroom in Colombo
cards.text: The same syllabus taught in person, for teams and individuals who work better away from their desk and their inbox.

cards.title: Self-paced
cards.text: Recorded modules with the same exercise files and workbooks, for people in awkward time zones or on shifting deadlines. Twelve months of access.

cards.title: Private and on-site
cards.text: A closed cohort for one organisation, taught on your own files and your own brand, on dates you choose. Quoted per group rather than per seat.

blocks.heading: What our certificate is, and what it is not
blocks.text: Finish a course and you receive a MyLearnPlus certificate of completion recording the title, the hours and the date. That is a record of training. It is not an Adobe credential. Adobe Certified Professional certification is a separate exam sat with Certiport, and the exam voucher is bought separately. Our Adobe courses are written against the published exam objectives so that you sit the exam knowing the interface and the vocabulary it uses, but no course can guarantee a pass.

steps.title: Book and get set up
steps.text: You receive joining instructions, the version and system requirements, and the exercise files. If your software is not installed yet, join the pre-class setup check and we will get you working before day one.

steps.title: Build something in class
steps.text: Each module ends with you producing a file, not watching one being produced. The instructor works at the pace of the room and reviews what you make.

steps.title: Leave with the material
steps.text: You keep the exercise files, the finished samples, the workbook and the class recording for twelve months, so the class is still useful when you need it three months later.

steps.title: Come back if you need to
steps.text: Every live booking includes one free retake of the same course within six months, subject to a free seat on the date you choose.

blocks.heading: Find the course you actually need
blocks.text: Browse the catalogue by software or by outcome. If you are not sure which level fits, send us the work you need to produce and we will tell you which class covers it.
